signature: def postorder_after_deletion(level_order: list[int | None], delete_key: int) -> list[int]:
statement: You are given level_order representing the level-order traversal of a binary search tree where missing children are present as null, and delete_key specifying a key to delete from the tree. Reconstruct the BST from level_order and delete delete_key from it, using its successor replacement when necessary. Return the postorder traversal of the resulting tree as a list ordered as left, right, root.

wrong_methods.name: uses the predecessor despite the successor rule
copies the successor without removing its old node
